# Live Coding, Counted Again

Live coding means you write a program while it runs, and the music or pictures change as you type. Thue gave us strings that rewrite themselves by fixed swaps. Brainfuck gives you eight symbols and a tape. I like putting the two together: rewrite a string, then tape the result. Every edit is a new piece, and so is every mistake. I still don't fully know how to make it sound good. That is the point of trying it.
